title: In the Café Right Now
gist_ar: وصف اللي بيحصل في الكافيه في اللحظة دي.
text: I am sitting in a café near my house. I usually come here on Fridays. Right now I am drinking tea and writing in my notebook. Outside it is raining, so the street is quiet. A man is standing near the door. He is wearing a black jacket and he is talking on the phone. Two students are sitting near the window. They are reading and they are waiting for their teacher. These days the café is busier than before, because the coffee is cheap and the internet is fast.

questions.q: What is the writer doing right now?
What is the man near the door wearing?
questions.q_ar: الراجل اللي جمب الباب لابس إيه؟

questions.q: What are the two students waiting for?
Why is the café busier these days?
options: The coffee is cheap and the internet is fast
